messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — HIGH — HorizonPay (enterprise, VPC) reports missing traces + delayed logs for their dedicated pool. auto-pager: @alex.k oncall
alex.k: taking. quick summary from CS Maya?
maya_cs: HorizonPay noticed requests returning 200 but traces/logs not appearing in their tenant slice. Metrics show their per-tenant request_count still rising, but spans are absent and traces endpoint returns 404 for tenant id. Customer is on Dedicated GPU pool in us-west2 + VPC forwarder.
jordan.s: tagging runtime/observability. any recent deploys to forwarder or the per-tenant ingestion bridge?
lee_r: nothing scheduled in runtime this morning. infra deployed a forwarder update last week (token rotation, tenant routing) — could be related.
alex.k: symptoms — live customer calls being processed but we can’t correlate them. customer-facing errors are low, but post-hoc debugging impossible. priority: restore trace/log access for HorizonPay or provide temporary replay/export.
pagerduty: @alex.k acknowledged the page
alex.k: first-step: confirm ingestion/filtering at the host level. @lee_r can you check the tenant routing table and shard mapping for HorizonPay tenant id = hp-8921 ?
lee_r: checking now. logs from forwarder show accept but then "no-match" for tenant partition.
lee_r: paste: ```
2026-02-13T15:04:12Z forwarder[main] INFO accepted request tenant=hp-8921 trace_id=... headers ok
2026-02-13T15:04:12Z forwarder[main] WARN tenant-mapper: no-match for hp-8921 -> dropping trace
```
jordan.s: that WARN looks like mapping table mismatch. maybe tenant binding to dedicated pool changed and mapper not reloaded.
maya_cs: customer confirmed they rotated their tenant-secret earlier today as part of routine key rotation.
alex.k: aha. token rotation + stale tenant map could mean forwarder rejects traces but still accepts requests (since frontend is authenticating differently). we need to confirm: are logs actually being dropped or routed to wrong silo?
lee_r: grep in S3 path for hp-8921: nothing new since 15:00. but the global logs (ingest-proxy) show packets forwarded to silo-id 0 (default) rather than the dedicated pool.
alex.k: impact: HorizonPay trace/search and per-tenant metrics are incomplete. Customer is on paged support. We need a mitigation path: 1) quick: rebind tenant mapping to dedicated pool (hotfix) 2) confirm token/policy sync 3) if hotfix risky, provide them a replay endpoint to pull raw request logs from us-west edge proxy until patch
jordan.s: I can push a mapping reload to the forwarder cluster (non-breaking) — it will reload tenant-config from config-store. can do in 2-3 mins. rollback safe.
lee_r: before reload, we should fetch current config-store entry for hp-8921. run:
```
aws ssm get-parameter --name "/tenants/hp-8921/mapping" --region us-west-2
```
lee_r: output shows shard: null, last_modified: 2026-02-13T12:58:02Z — likely the rotation cleared shard binding.
alex.k: do reload. jordan, coordinate.
jordan.s: executing reload now — calling runtime-reload job: `kubectl -n forwarder rollout restart deploy/tenant-mapper` (safe)
incidents-bot: deploy bot: rollout restart triggered by jordan.s for namespace forwarder
jordan.s: done. mapper logs:
```
2026-02-13T15:07:40Z tenant-mapper INFO reload config from s3://tenant-config/2026/02/13
2026-02-13T15:07:41Z tenant-mapper INFO bound hp-8921 -> pool-dedicated-us-west2
```
jordan.s: new routing active. I see traces being accepted now on forwarder and forwarded to pool-dedicated-us-west2. alerting: spans arriving for hp-8921.
lee_r: confirmed in pool logs: traces for hp-8921 started at 15:07:42 and continue. writing to tenant-S3 path.
maya_cs: I asked customer to check. HorizonPay: "We see traces show up in dashboard now for the last 30s. thank you." They want root cause and assurance.
alex.k: root cause hypoth: tenant mapping cleared/stale due to key rotation workflow that didn't rebind shard. Follow-ups: 1) patch rotation playbook to ensure mapping persists 2) add health-check that verifies per-tenant spans in the last 5m after token rotation 3) add alert when tenant-mapper binds to null/shard
jordan.s: +1. I'll open an incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime for a fix and to platform for playbook update.
alex.k: create customer-facing incident summary and offer a one-time replay of missing traces for up to 3 hours window while we audit.
maya_cs: drafting message to HorizonPay: "We identified a mismatch between tenant mapping and token rotation which prevented traces from being routed to your dedicated pool. We have reloaded the mapping which restored trace ingestion. We're preparing a replay of missing traces and will follow up with steps we've taken and preventive measures." will send after legal/PS review.
lee_r: temporary mitigation note: added a guard to tenant-mapper to reject clearing shard for active tenants. patch pushed to canary. snippet:
```
- if tenant.active and new.shard == null:
+ if tenant.active and new.shard == null:
   reject update and alert
```
alex.k: good. next: confirm replay path. jordan, can we trigger a replay from edge logs for hp-8921 for 12:30-15:07 window to a secure S3 and share presigned link to customer? we must redact PII.
jordan.s: yes. starting replay job now: `replay-run --tenant hp-8921 --from 2026-02-13T12:30:00Z --to 2026-02-13T15:07:00Z --dest s3://replay-hp-8921/2026-02-13/` (eta ~6m)
incidents-bot: Replay job queued. job-id: rpj-22019
jordan.s: replay finished. uploaded to s3. generating presigned URL (24h expiry).
jordan.s: presigned: https://s3-presign.example/rep-hp-8921?exp=24h
maya_cs: sending to customer with note: process for ingesting/reconsiliating replayed traces and SSO to their observability portal.
alex.k: closing the page once customer confirms stable and after follow-ups created. action items:
- eng-runtime: investigate why config-store entry became null on rotation (ticket RN-6421)
- platform: update rotation playbook + add health-check (RN-6422)
- product/ops: consider automated mapping-sanity alert for any enterprise tenant (RN-6423)
- cs: deliver replay and customer note + postmortem timeline (RN-6424)
maya_cs: customer happy for now, will confirm after they validate historical trace continuity.
alex.k: thanks team. I'll keep the thread open until CS confirms. :white_check_mark:
maya_cs: confirmed 15:22Z — HorizonPay validated traces and accepted replay. closing on-call handoff to eng-runtime for root cause and fix.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — reduced severity. auto-note: duration 18m."
